idea-plugin.name: LiveApiTester - AI-Powered API Tester
idea-plugin.description:
LiveApiTester — AI-Powered Live API Testing Plugin for IntelliJ IDEA.

Like Postman/Bruno but embedded directly in the IDE, powered by AI (OpenAI-compatible).


Features:
  • 🚀 Live HTTP client: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS
  • 🤖 AI-powered error explanation (OpenAI-compatible)
  • 🤖 AI test case generation for any endpoint
  • 🤖 AI-generated request body samples
  • 🔍 Auto-scan Spring Boot & JAX-RS endpoints from your project
  • 📁 Collections: save and organize requests
  • 🌍 Environments: manage dev/staging/prod variables with {{variable}} interpolation
  • 📜 Request history: replay previous requests
  • 🔐 Auth: Bearer Token, Basic Auth, API Key
  • ⚙️ Configurable AI endpoint, model, and timeouts
